components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The global filled action for one clear next step.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-primary">Create your event <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="m13 6 6 6-6 6"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--chestnut, #4a2415); color: #fff; font: 600 16px "DM Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--chestnut-strong, #31170c); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2c5c85); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A transparent Chestnut outline for a real but subordinate action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--chestnut, #4a2415); border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--chestnut, #4a2415); font: 600 16px "DM Sans", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--chestnut, #4a2415); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2c5c85); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The standard labelled 48px field on the quiet inset Field surface.
components.css: .ds-field { width: min(420px, 100%); display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink, #2b1d17); font: 600 14px "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-field input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9cec2); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--field, #fffdf8); color: var(--ink, #2b1d17); font: 600 16px "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #766c70); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2c5c85); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: A major working surface separated by tone, one rule, and only a trace of lift.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-paper-card { box-sizing: border-box; width: min(420px, 100%); padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d9cec2); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--paper, #fffaf3); color: var(--ink, #2b1d17); box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgb(74 36 21 / 5%); font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-paper-card__label { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--chestnut, #4a2415); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .13em; } .ds-paper-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 26px/1.12 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-paper-card p:last-child { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #766c70); line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Completion Status
components.description: A compact textual receipt marker; Moss supports the state but never carries it alone.
components.css: .ds-status-success { width: fit-content; padding: 6px 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--moss-soft, #e8ecd8); color: var(--completion-ink, #4e5b28); font: 700 12px "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-status-success svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.25; } .ds-status-success:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2c5c85); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-public-header { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 88px; padding: 0 5vw; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #d9cec2); background: var(--paper, #fffaf3); color: var(--ink, #2b1d17); font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-brand { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; color: var(--chestnut, #4a2415); font: 700 21.6px Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand__mark { width: 28px; height: 27px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-brand__mark i { width: 7px; display: block; border-radius: 5px 5px 2px 2px; background: var(--denim, #3f6d95); } .ds-brand__mark i:nth-child(1) { height: 15px; transform: rotate(-14deg); } .ds-brand__mark i:nth-child(2) { height: 25px; background: var(--chestnut, #4a2415); } .ds-brand__mark i:nth-child(3) { height: 17px; transform: rotate(12deg); } .ds-public-header nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-public-header nav a { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: var(--muted, #766c70); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-public-header .ds-header-cta { padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--chestnut, #4a2415); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--chestnut, #4a2415); } .ds-public-header a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2c5c85); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-public-header { min-height: 70px; padding: 0 20px; } .ds-brand { font-size: 16.8px; } }

components.name: Manager Navigation Item

components.css: .ds-manager-nav-item { box-sizing: border-box; min-width: 184px; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--denim-soft, #dde7f0); color: var(--chestnut, #4a2415); font: 600 14px "DM Sans", sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-manager-nav-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; } .ds-manager-nav-item strong { min-width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-left: auto; padding: 0 5px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--chestnut, #4a2415); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; } .ds-manager-nav-item:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--denim-soft, #dde7f0) 74%, var(--denim, #3f6d95)); } .ds-manager-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2c5c85); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-rsvp-person { box-sizing: border-box; width: min(420px, 100%); margin: 0; padding: 15px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--event-border, #e3dcd8); border-radius: var(--event-card-radius, 10px); background: var(--event-raised-surface, #fff); color: var(--event-text, #352924); font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif; } .ds-rsvp-person legend { padding: 0 5px; color: var(--event-page-text, #2b1d17); font: 800 16px Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-rsvp-person div { margin-top: 5px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; } .ds-rsvp-person label { min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--event-input-border, #928a84); border-radius: var(--event-input-radius, 11px); background: var(--event-surface, #fffaf3); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rsvp-person label:has(input:checked) { border: 2px solid var(--event-primary, #4a2415); } .ds-rsvp-person input { width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--event-primary, #4a2415); } .ds-rsvp-person input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--event-focus, #2c5c85); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The Quiet Event Ledger treats each event as a private record being carefully kept. Warm paper, dark ink, and restrained accents make the product intimate enough for weddings and private gatherings, while its hierarchy remains operationally precise: every phase, credential, delivery, and recovery state should be understood without interpretation.

Photography carries the emotion; interface chrome carries the truth. Public surfaces may feel editorial and generous, Manager surfaces become structured and compact, and guest surfaces narrow to one calm task at a time. The system rejects generic wedding SaaS, gallery-first social feeds, cold enterprise dashboards, and glassy or translucent effects that weaken legibility.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, opaque paper grounds with dark ink and thin rules.
Chestnut for action, Denim for selection and active state, Moss for completion, and Danger red for refusal or loss.
Manrope for compact editorial hierarchy; DM Sans for direct, readable operation.
Mobile-first composition with visible labels and 44–48px controls.
Flat-by-default surfaces with lift reserved for paper cards, event frames, and photographs.
Globally branded chrome with a curated, scoped event-theme overlay.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Chestnut acts, Denim selects or informs, Moss confirms completion, and Danger red names refusal or loss. Never exchange those meanings for decoration.

rules.name: The Global Chrome Rule
rules.body: Public, account, create, host, Manager, browser, loading, and pre-authentication surfaces stay on the global palette. Curated event themes are confined to authenticated guest, RSVP, fullscreen, and preview surfaces.

rules.name: The Constrained Theme Rule
rules.body: Event appearance comes from the four server-resolved presets and optional validated primary/accent overrides. Never generate raw CSS, new font choices, arbitrary URLs, or a parallel image system.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Use only the bundled Manrope and DM Sans families for product UI. A private event may change semantic colors and radii, never typography.

rules.name: The Compact Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings use short measures, high weight, tight tracking, and no script or ornamental wedding type.

rules.name: The Narrow-First Rule
rules.body: Resolve the complete task at 320px before opening columns, rails, or decorative breathing room.

rules.name: The One Primary Canvas Rule
rules.body: RSVP, before-start, waiting, and photo delivery share one narrow guest frame; secondary gallery, notes, and prior deliveries never compete with the current task.

rules.name: The Labeled Navigation Rule
rules.body: Every Manager destination remains visibly named at every width; icon-only navigation is not part of this system.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use ground color, surface color, and one-pixel rules to establish structure. Add a shadow only when the element behaves like held paper, a framed event surface, or a physical photograph.

rules.name: The Arch and Print Rule
rules.body: Reserve the tall arch and overlapping square prints for photographic storytelling; ordinary product panels remain gently rectangular.

rules.name: The No Bubble Drift Rule
rules.body: Pills belong to compact statuses, counts, and completion markers. Do not turn navigation, prose, or ordinary cards into floating capsules.

rules.name: The State Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Every selected, pending, delivered, failed, and disabled state must remain legible through text, geometry, or an icon in addition to color.

rules.name: The Quiet Tactility Rule
rules.body: Controls may move by one pixel, deepen one semantic color, or reveal a focus outline; they do not glow, bounce, blur, or perform decorative motion.

dos: **Do** use the global Parchment, Paper, Ink, Chestnut, Denim, Moss, Danger, Border, and Focus roles before adding any new visual value.
**Do** keep core controls at least 44px high, with 48px as the standard field and button height.
**Do** let photographs carry celebration while surrounding controls remain calm, opaque, and specific.
**Do** preserve visible labels, textual status, focus movement, reduced-motion behavior, and narrow-width containment.
**Do** resolve event appearance through the existing preset registry and semantic token adapter.
donts: **Don't** introduce script fonts, confetti motifs, pastel wedding clichés, glass panels, or generic SaaS gradients.
**Don't** make gallery, notes, badges, or decorative metrics compete with the current RSVP or delivery task.
**Don't** hide Manager labels, use color as the only state signal, or shrink controls below the touch floor.
**Don't** spread shadows across every surface; most hierarchy comes from spacing, paper tones, and rules.
**Don't** permit raw event CSS, arbitrary fonts, external assets, unvalidated colors, or unknown theme fields.
**Don't** reinterpret browser emulation as proof of a physical phone, camera picker, VoiceOver, or TalkBack.
